rationale: itnet-claude-agentic: pretrain_epochs=100, pretrain_lr=0.001, itnet_k=1, itnet_alpha=0.0, unet_c=16, finetune_epochs=0, finetune_lr=0.0001, train_n=800, val_n=200, grad_clip=1.0, seed=42, rationale=iter-10 (breast ItNet v1). SIX-BOX: (1) PRIOR: iter-8 (tn800,ep60=48000 steps) 0.8842 CHAMPION; iter-9 (tn1600,ep30=48000 steps) 0.8840 FLAT -> scene diversity SATURATES ~800 at fixed compute (and ep30 may undertrain each scene). lr/alpha/width levers already exhausted or below champion. (2) FAILURE MODE: at fixed 48000 grad steps the denoiser plateaus ~0.884; the remaining lever is TOTAL COMPUTE (more grad steps) at the good train_n=800. (3) ONE KNOB (from champion iter-8): pretrain_epochs 60 -> 100 (tn800 fixed). 800x100 = 80000 grad steps (1.67x iter-8). (4) HYPOTHESIS: if I give the denoiser MORE total training at the diversity-saturating train_n=800, I expect hr above 0.8842 because iter-9 showed diversity is saturated but each scene at ep60 may be undertrained; more epochs lowers denoiser loss further. FALSIFIER: if hr<=0.8842, the pure-denoiser architecture is near its ceiling ~0.884 at c16 and MORE compute wont help -> iter-11 must change ARCHITECTURE (width at matched-or-more compute, or add a residual/normalization) rather than training budget. (5) BUDGET: 80000 steps ~ 1.67x iter-8s 890s ~= 1490s; turbo -> within 20-min wall (iter-8 ran 890s, headroom to ~1200s+). If TIMEOUT, re-dispatch ep80. (6) Loop to iter-20.
